name: Padel Score — Wrist
description:
Keep your focus on the game.

Gesture scoring
Optional. Off for every new game.
One series means touching your thumb and index finger together twice.
One series: us. Two: them. Three: cancel. Wait five seconds to save.
For THEM, wait for “Pending: US”, then repeat the series: two finger contacts.
Requires watchOS 11 and an Apple Watch that supports Double Tap, with the screen awake and system gestures enabled.

Recover an accurate score. Replace the current score with the score everyone agrees on, or change, remove or insert an earlier recorded rally while keeping later winners in order. Review the score and serving consequences before applying; one Undo restores the whole correction. Start Match or Americano from a known score with explicit serving. Earlier rallies remain unknown. Match sets are unrestricted; finish when you choose. Add optional player names on your Watch. Names and games stay local. Selective corrections apply only to the active game or latest editable result, after its last checkpoint.

DURING THE GAME
• Match: games and sets, with a tie-break at 6–6.
• Choose Golden point, One advantage, or Advantage at deuce.
• Confirm serving order for each new set.
• Americano: score your own round with a shared rally total and serves per player.
• See each team’s points, rallies remaining, and the next server.
• Undo a tap or correct the score and serving order.
• Return to your saved game after closing the app.

AFTER THE GAME
• Read completed set scores and any incomplete set. Finish a Match whenever you choose.
• See an Americano round’s final points, including a draw or an early finish.
• Use Play again from the latest result to reuse its rules and serving order. Check the first server before starting.
• Browse all your finished games in local History, with dates and detailed results. History is free, including after the five-game limit.

FIVE GAMES FREE
The first five completed real games are free automatically. After that, one lifetime purchase unlocks unlimited new games. Your current game, latest result, history, and demo stay accessible without purchasing. Deleting local game data does not reset the completed-game count.

Buying and restoring require an internet connection to the App Store. Use About → Access → Restore purchases with the Apple Account used for the purchase.

Games and history stay locally on this Watch. There is no transfer between Watches, cloud sync, or cloud backup service in the app. Removing the app or changing Watches may lose local data. Americano scoring covers your own round, without tournament scheduling or standings.

Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later. Available in English, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil), Dutch, German, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian Bokmål, and Russian. No ads.

Privacy: https://padel-score-wrist.pages.dev/privacy/
Terms: https://padel-score-wrist.pages.dev/terms/

ON YOUR IPHONE
Get started with a short guide, try interactive Match and Americano demos, and get or restore lifetime access. Real games stay on your Apple Watch, which works independently. Demos work offline and do not use your free games. Use the same Apple Account on both devices; history and the free-game count stay on the Watch. The iPhone companion requires iOS 17 or later.
